radiology_report:
Subject: Multiparametric MRI Prostate
Institution: Ziekenhuis Gelderse Vallei (Ede)
Date: 20 Feb 2025
Clinical Indication:
Assessment prompted by a PSA value of 7.0 and a previously Positive biopsy.
FINDINGS:
The gland measures 94.53 mL. T2 sequences highlight a discrete hypointense focus within the left peripheral zone, spanning from the base toward the mid-gland at roughly 18 mm. Diffusion mapping reveals intense restriction, mirrored by low ADC signals. Contrast dynamics show prompt, focal uptake. Seminal vesicles remain clear. No malignant-appearing nodes or bone abnormalities are visualized.
IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left peripheral zone.
PSA density: 0.07 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa probability 0.7873657.

previous_notes.author: Dr. P. van Dijk (GP)
previous_notes.text: Early 2023 screening showed an initial PSA level of 3.2 ng/mL. A follow-up measurement performed three months later remained unchanged, leading to a urology referral for detailed evaluation. Clinical monitoring continued alongside the workup, which has now concluded, placing the case under review following the most recent laboratory and imaging data.
